newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 2.311 billion yuan from 1.024 billion on Thursday and the 30-day contract was the most active.
Traders said that turnover rose sharply with active trading seen from some major state-run banks which had been on the sidelines in the past few weeks.
Market rumours said the central bank would start open market operations in the second quarter of 1997, local traders said.
Officials were not immediately available for comment.
